text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, I shall leave matters in your 
capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I have been meaning to ask for some 
time now, but what exactly does 'Okemaru 
Suisan' mean?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was able to deduce that you used the 
former to mean "OK," but what does "marine 
products" mean...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So you deal in marine products... is that 
it? How does that connect to 'OK'?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Like, fish is super tasty, right? Good 
food boosts the vibes, and makes it a 
totally legit vibe, ya know?☆"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it is so delicious that 
you will inevitably say yes? Put another 
way, it is an excellent proposal, and 
saying yes is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for real?! Your comprehension is 
god-tier!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Even so, this is 
truly profound. You are exceptionally 
knowledgeable, Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you're making me blush~! Ask me 
anything you want!!
